source.rightsEvidence: The pinned source template contains its original CC BY 3.0 license text and attribution README in rights/. The adapted local screenshots and generated imagery are separately recorded there.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: Big Picture presents a full-page sequence of image-backed, near-full-viewport chapters. The opening is a training poster with large uppercase headline and one early CTA. Two following photo scenes use opposite side-anchored dark content panels and directional down links. A bright gallery chapter changes the surface and rhythm; a warm, separate contact chapter closes the experience. A transparent compact header overlays the hero and becomes more solid after scrolling. Mobile retains the strong poster and chapter sequence but disables fixed background attachment and desktop scroll snapping, scales the display type, and turns the image gallery into a two-column grid. The photographs and fictional studio are generated placeholders. Transfer mechanics only, not exact copy, identity, imagery, or trade dress.

heroGeometry.alignment: large central statement over atmospheric image
heroGeometry.viewport: headline, brief promise, and first-step scroll action visible in a 900 px desktop viewport

navigationGeometry.placement: top edge above the hero image
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact inline header with readable links and no overlay takeover

typography.display: bold condensed grotesk or system sans
typography.scale: oversized uppercase poster headline with compact numbered chapter labels

palette.ink: chalk-white on image panels and near-black on light chapters
palette.contrastIntent: strong contrast with image overlays and separate light gallery surfaces

imageTreatment.mode: atmospheric full-bleed studio scenes plus bright gallery
imageTreatment.crop: cover on desktop, subject-safe responsive crop on mobile, object-fit thumbnails in gallery
imageTreatment.focalPoint: movement and equipment stay visible behind readable copy

servicePresentation.pattern: one concise offering inside a side-anchored image chapter followed by a short process list
servicePresentation.interaction: directional scroll links advance to the next chapter

ctaPlacement.secondary: contextual link in services and final intake form

motion.primitive: scroll-linked chapter entrance and header surface transition
motion.library: native CSS, anchor scrolling, and IntersectionObserver
motion.reducedMotion: disable snapping and animation while preserving all sections and direct anchors

rules: shrink display type before changing the message
keep nav and CTA in view without overlap

prohibitedPatterns: scroll locks or long scrub animations

requiredSignatureElements.description: full-screen fitness poster with prominent headline
right-anchored panel within an image-backed service chapter
opposite side-anchored approach chapter with short process list

acceptanceChecks: At 1440 by 900, the opening image, title, and first-step link fit without clipping.
The next two chapters alternate content-panel alignment over distinct training images.
A contrasting gallery section and separate final contact section follow the image chapters.
At 390 by 844, image backgrounds scroll normally, gallery has two columns, and no page-level horizontal overflow occurs.
Motion never hides required copy, traps scrolling, or claims real fitness outcomes.

review.notes: Verified desktop and mobile full-page captures, image loading, responsive chapter sequence, two-column gallery, reduced mobile overflow, and local-only inquiry form. The six gallery crops reuse three generated scenes and are illustrative only.
